name_ja: たのしみグローバルⅢ（定率増加プラン）
policy_name_ja: 5年ごと利差配当付選択通貨建個人年金保険（一時払い）（23）
policy_names_ja: 5年ごと利差配当付選択通貨建個人年金保険（一時払い）（23）
5年ごと利差配当付指定通貨建個人年金保険（一時払い）（20）
notes: Policy names: (23) 選択通貨建 covers USD, AUD and JPY; (20) 指定通貨建 covers USD and AUD only. The 5-year / 10-year 据置期間 and the 目標額設定なし / あり choice are plan options of the one product.
Rate history on the site starts with the 責任開始日 period 2023-06-16 to 06-30 (contract date 2023-07-16) (the on-sale date is recorded in on_sale_date).

effective_date in the rate CSVs is the first day of the 責任開始日 period (the half-month in which the policy is taken up), the same period the current-rate page quotes. The site's tables also show one 契約日 per period, about a month later; it is not stored.
積立利率 and 実質的な利回り are the same number (the rate page says 実質的な利回りは積立利率と同じになります), so no separate net_yield series is collected. For USD and AUD contracts the yield is in that currency, not in yen.
Rates are set on the 1st and 16th. 円建 is not offered with 目標額設定あり; those cells are stored as not_offered. A dash on the site means the currency was suspended for that period.
目標額設定なし 円建 5年: the rate page says new contracts under JPY 3 million are not accepted when 積立利率 is below 0.45%.

MVA rate (市場価格調整用利率) history is collected from the MVA tab's back numbers, keyed by the same periods (the table header reads 責任開始日・解約返戻金計算基準日). Without a 目標額 the MVA rate is driven by USD assets whatever the contract currency (site note).

Channel comparison (checked 2026-11-16): chid=cmon (ntg edition) and chid=smtb show the same current 積立利率 as chid=cgin for 目標額設定なし (USD 4.40/4.80, AUD 3.70/4.40, JPY 2.30/2.40) and offer no 目標額設定あり column. chid=mzho returns only a redirect page to the insurer's general page; no Mizuho page exists for this plan (tanoshimiglobal3_teiritsu_mizuho.html is a 404). Channel history is not collected.
Not collected: the sibling たのしみグローバルⅢ（指数連動プラン）; the FX tables on the rate page (TTM+/-0.50 yen, snapshotted only); rates for contracts before the 2023-06 launch period.

Distributor list is as of 2026-10-01 from the finance page; the page also has an index-linked plan list, which is excluded. The しんきんらいふ年金S edition links its own 取扱い金融機関一覧, which is not collected, so shinkin banks beyond those listed are missing.
The ittaigata brochure URL comes from the product brief; its relation to this plan page has not been checked.

Launch date: 2023-06-16, the sales start stated in the insurer's news release of 2023-06-09 (一時払個人年金保険「たのしみグローバルⅢ（指数連動プラン）」「たのしみグローバルⅢ（定率増加プラン）」, sold at SMBC and SMBC Nikko Securities as 「たのしみステップⅢ」 for the 指数連動プラン). It follows 「たのしみグローバルⅡ」 (on sale from 2020-10), to which the Ⅲ edition added a yen option. Retrieved 2026-11-17.
notes_en: This is the fixed-rate increase plan; the index-linked plan is tracked separately as a candidate product.
Net yield equals the crediting rate, so no separate net yield series is kept.
Dates are the start of the period in which cover begins, not the policy date a month later.
Regional-bank and Sumitomo Mitsui Trust rate pages showed the same current rates as the general page.
Launched 16 June 2023 (insurer news release); rate history starts the same day.
With a target set, the yen option is not offered.
